//: Without this file the scene does not run, and it does not say so.
vite reads the JSX settings for esbuild out of tsconfig. With no tsconfig,
esbuild uses the classic transform, so `<Rect/>` compiles to a call to
`React.createElement` -- which does not exist in the page -- and the scene
module throws while it loads. The browser tab dies, and puppeteer reports
the only thing it can see: 'Navigating frame was detached'. Hours of that
error point at Chrome, at sandboxing and at the headless flags; none of it
`jsxImportSource` has to be `@revideo/2d/lib`, matching the pragma at the
top of the scene: it is the built JS, and the bare package points at source.
